run_script_with_tbb: run a python script under TBB context using python -m tbb script.py
create_tbb_pool: create a TBB-backed thread pool with Pool(nworkers) for parallel task execution
use_monkey_context: use tbb.Monkey context manager to replace multiprocessing.pool with TBB pools
test_tbb_pool: test the TBB pool implementation by running python -m tbb _test -v
map_parallel_with_tbb: map a function over an iterable in parallel using pool.map(func, iterable)
